page.layout: One column of running text, with Hebrew, Greek and Latin inline. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top left. No marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: habent אנ התחתאלהים[?]; sic etiam ambæ versiones Samaritanæ, Judaica ac- dunt כי[?], differentiam ibi nullam notas, qvasi tuum exhiberet כי[?]. Una versio ve- rit אנה[?] דחול אלח[?] Timens Deum ego sum: Cui consentit Onkelos & Jo- nathan Chaldæi interpretes, & antiqva Pentateuchi Samaritani versio Græca, cujus vestigia nonnulla deprehendun- tur in Scholiis, qvæ citantur in Editione 70 interpretum Sixtiana, ἡ γὰρ Φοβού- μένῳ Θεὸν εἰμὶ ἐγώ[?]. Si in tuo exem- plari revera est כי[?] videtur sic legisse in- terpres Græcus. Sed interptetes illi,& Samarita & Græcus, in textu Hebræo Samaritano,&Chaldæi in Hebræo Judai- co dictionis התחת[?] litteras sic permu- tatas legerunt התחת[?]. Altera Samarita- na versio qvam edidimus החלופת[?] אלהים אנה[?] Numqvid vice Dei ego sum? ut legunt & interpretantur Judæi, & antiqvitus legerunt Symmachus & A- qvila 70 non legerunt ה[?], sed sic, כיתחת אלהים אנ[?], ut ex versione manifestum est. Præterea ejusdem 50.
main_text.notes: Hebrew and Greek glyphs are set in a larger, partly damaged type; several Hebrew words (marked [?]) are uncertain, and one Hebrew word is shown as a printed box glyph. The Greek "ἡ γὰρ Φοβούμενῳ Θεὸν εἰμὶ ἐγώ" is a doubtful copy of the printed Greek. The text runs on past "50." to the catchword "cap." at the lower right, so the paragraph is not closed by a full stop there. Printed spelling is kept (e.g. "Interptetes", "Samarita", "qvam").
